data.cultural_impact: The name Chaturaanan is rooted in Hindu mythology and culture where many gods and goddesses have four arms, each holding a symbolic item. This name signifies the divine power and strength that embodies these deities, inspiring awe and reverence in those who bear or hear it.
data.spiritual_significance: For Hindus, the number four represents the four pillars of dharma (righteousness), artha (prosperity), kama (desire), and moksha (liberation). The name Chaturaanan connects one spiritually to these core aspects of life through the divine example of gods and goddesses with four arms, instilling a sense of balance, strength, and purpose.
